name: What factors influence the cost of window trim installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of window trim installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of window trim installation is influenced by several factors: the type of material chosen (e.g., solid wood vs. PVC), the complexity of the trim profile (e.g., simple casing vs. ornate designs), the number of windows, and the condition of the existing frames. Custom-milled trim or extensive repairs to the window frame before installation will also increase costs. Hometelligent Inc. provides detailed quotes based on these specific project variables.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost factors include trim material, profile complexity, number of windows, and existing frame condition. Custom trim or repairs can also affect the final price.
